descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and backend services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Build and optimize event-driven data processing solutions using Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Eventarc, and other GCP services.
Develop and maintain data integrations between backend systems, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), such as Zeotap, and Customer Engagement Platforms (CEP).
Implement data workflows supporting cross-channel customer communications, marketing automation, and personalized customer journeys.
Develop and optimize data processing logic, SQL queries, and data transformations to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability.
Work with BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataform, and Datastore to support data ingestion, transformation, and storage requirements.
Build and maintain automated workflows using Cloud Workflows and Cloud Scheduler.
Integrate third-party APIs and external systems to enable seamless data exchange across multiple platforms.
Manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and implement CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
Ensure data pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and maintainability across multi-country implementations.
Collaborate with international teams to deliver robust data solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.
 RequirementsMust-Have Skills 
Strong experience in data engineering, including designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and data integration solutions.
Strong Python programming skills for data processing, backend development, and API integrations.
Solid SQL skills and experience with data transformation and optimization.
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage.
Familiarity with Dataform, Datastore, Cloud Workflows, and Cloud Scheduler.
Experience building event-driven architectures and integrating third-party APIs.
Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (HCL).
Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
Fluent English and the ability to work effectively in an international team.
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDP), particularly Zeotap.
Familiarity with Customer Engagement Platforms (CEP) and marketing automation solutions, such as Oracle Responsys.
Experience integrating messaging platforms and APIs, including WhatsApp Business, SMS gateways, push notifications (FCM/APNs), RCS, and Apple/Google Wallet.
Knowledge of customer engagement data flows, triggered campaigns, and cross-channel communication orchestration.
Experience supporting multi-country implementations, including localization, consent management, and country-specific opt-in requirements.
